overrides_applied.reason: WP7: "non-EMI retail spend" restates retail spend (EMI principal on IRCTC is negligible); the key made the 5X rule info.

WP7: T&C: 5X on IRCTC spends made through IRCTC Ticketing Website / Rail Connect App and HDFC Bank SmartBuy - alternatives, all identified by IRCTC MIDs; the merchant (IRCTC) carries it. As written the loader AND-ed IRCTC with SmartBuy.
WP7: "retail spend" restates the catch-all; the key made the other-spends rule info, so its 1,000/month cap never applied.
WP7: T&C: "Reward Points on other spends is capped maximum at 1000 Reward Points per month and 12000 Reward Points Annually." With no rule naming it, the loader made it card-wide.
WP7: T&C: the 12,000 RP annual cap is on "the 5X Reward Points on partner IRCTC spends"; category inference also tied it to the SmartBuy cashback rule.

WP7: T&C: "The accrual of the 5% Cashback on IRCTC Train Ticket booking made via HDFC Bank SmartBuy is capped maximum at INR 1000 per month and INR 12000 Annually" - the cashback rule only; category inference also tied it to the 5X points rule.
